resources.string: A cat who lives on your home screen. Each time you come back to it she does something new, and from 23:00 to 07:00 she sleeps.
If that does not open, long-press the home screen and choose Wallpapers, then Live wallpapers, then Lili.
Not set: Lili isn’t your wallpaper yet. Tap Preview, keep Home screen on and tap Apply.
Lili is on: home and lock screen (animated)
Lili is on: home screen, and her picture on the lock screen
Lili is on: lock screen (her picture)
Lili takes the home screen after Apply
Your previous wallpaper comes back after Apply
Lili picture from %1$s, no longer updated
Not available. Android doesn’t let apps animate the lock screen. On stock Android (Pixel, Motorola…), turn on Home screen and choose “Home screen and lock screen” in the picker.
Choose “Home screen and lock screen” to have her on the lock screen too, on phones that allow it (stock Android). Huawei, Samsung, Xiaomi and Oppo show her on the home screen only.
Choose “Home screen” on the next screen.
Choose “Home screen and lock screen” on the next screen.
Android doesn’t let Lili read your current wallpaper, so she can’t save it. When you turn her off, she puts back “My wallpaper” if she has it, or lets you choose a photo or the system default.
Could not put the wallpaper back: %1$s
Your previous home-screen wallpaper wasn’t saved. What should replace Lili there?
Your previous lock-screen wallpaper wasn’t saved. What should replace Lili there?
Huawei: if her picture does not show on the lock screen, turn off Magazine unlock. For updates every few hours, let Lili run in the background (Battery, App launch, Manage manually).
To keep a copy of your current wallpaper, allow Lili “All files access”. Android 13 and newer allow reading the wallpaper only with this permission. Lili reads nothing else.
Your current wallpaper is animated, so there is no picture of it to keep. If you have it as a photo, pick it to keep it as “My wallpaper”.
Lili couldn’t get a copy of your current wallpaper. If you have it as a photo, pick it to keep it as “My wallpaper”.
Set Lili as your wallpaper first to capture your real home screen
Tap the picture to hide this panel.
On the next screen, choose “Entire screen”.
Lili is capturing your home screen
Your home screen is in the preview now.
Lili couldn’t find her wallpaper in the capture. Choose “Entire screen” and try again.
No place set, so the weather is invented
Lili dresses for the weather there and picks her animations by it; the weather itself is never shown. Only the coordinates are sent, or the city you search for.
Updated %1$s · %2$s (the last update failed; Lili tries again later)
No data yet: the weather service couldn’t be reached. Lili tries again later.
Real weather is off: the weather is invented, and Lili uses no network.
Couldn’t search. Check the connection and try again.
Without location access, search for your city instead.
Location is off. Turn it on, or search for your city.
Couldn’t find your location. Search for your city instead.
She does not react to touch yet.
Android System WebView is not available right now. Lili will appear when it is.
